verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is a Python library/CLI with async API, Docker/FastAPI deployment, and a documented CLI, all of which support headless scripted or CI-based automation without a browser UI; GitHub and docs confirm Docker setup, CLI, and checkpoint/resume support for pipeline use. Community evidence shows real-world integration with automation tools like n8n and MCP for Cursor/Claude, though users note extra work needed for production hardening (rate limiting, policy layers).
